coral-pop.$description: Coral Pop — Orange action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

terracotta-whisper.$description: Terracotta Whisper — Orange accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis.

cream-linen.$description: Cream Linen — Primary page canvas — every section background. The signature surface: warm, not white, immediately domestic. Used for the hero band, the about/letter section, the category circles area, and footer transitions

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, logo, all hairline borders on nav buttons/cards/circles/icons, and the thin rules that define almost every component — the structural skeleton of the entire interface

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated.

stone.$description: Stone — Subtle dividers and rules that recede — used where a border needs to exist for spatial structure without competing with the primary black borders

bone.$description: Bone — Warm gray for footer borders, input field backgrounds, and the faintest surface separation — the slightly cooler cousin of Cream Linen for creating quiet contrast

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces and button text — the only true white in the system, reserved for elevated elements that need to pop above the cream canvas

mist.$description: Mist — Card borders where a soft outline is needed without the weight of black — quieter than #707070, used on the product card grid in the New Arrivals section

gascognets.$description: Display and heading serif — used for hero headlines like "Buttercream, whipped to perfection." and section titles like "New Arrivals". This old-style serif is the editorial voice of the brand; it carries the warmth that the sans-serif cannot. Weight 500 for emphasis without going bold. The 1.0–1.2 line-height on 39–52px sizes is tight, creating a confident, magazine-display feel rather than airy editorial

basis-grotesque-pro.$description: Primary body and UI sans-serif — nav labels, button text, body copy, product descriptions, and the "NEW" label. The consistently positive letter-spacing (0.019–0.031em) is distinctive: most grotesques tighten tracking at body sizes, but this one opens it, creating a calm, unhurried reading rhythm that matches the domestic warmth. Weight stays at 400 — no bold/medium variations, keeping the voice quiet and conversational

basisgrotesquepro-mono.$description: Monospace variant used for input fields, code-like UI elements, and the uppercase "NEW" label (at 0.056em — the widest tracking in the system, giving small labels a stamped, editorial feel). The wider 0.056em at the label sizes creates the signature tracked-out uppercase micro-text that appears in coral above hero headlines
